HomeHero.welcomeDescription: Ngaahi vitio fakatui mei heʻemau laipeli ke fakaueʻiloto, pole, mo fakaʻaiʻai ʻa e fakakaukau loloto.
HomeHero.morningTitle: Mālō e lelei ki he pongipongi ni! ʻOku Tatali Mai ʻa e Ngaahi Taimi Tohi Tapu ʻo e ʻAho Ni.
HomeHero.morningDescription: Kamata ho ʻaho ʻaki ha ngaahi taimi Tohi Tapu fakalototoʻa ke fakaueʻiloto mo fakaivia ho laumālie.
HomeHero.afternoonTitle: Mālō e lelei ki he hoʻatā ni! Ngaahi Taimi Tohi Tapu ki Ho ʻAho.
HomeHero.afternoonDescription: Ngaahi vitio Tohi Tapu fakalototoʻa ʻoku lelei ki hoʻo mālōlō hoʻatā pe ke hoko atu hoʻo fakaueʻiloto.
HomeHero.eveningTitle: Mālō e lelei ki he efiafi ni! Mālōlō mo e Ngaahi Taimi Tohi Tapu.
HomeHero.eveningDescription: Ngaahi taimi Tohi Tapu nonga ke tokoni ke ke fakakaukau loloto mo maʻu ha fiemālie ʻi he ngata ʻa ho ʻaho.
HomeHero.joinUsTitle: ʻOku fekumi ʻa e kakai ʻe lauipiliona

HomeHero.togetherTitle: Fakamatalaʻi ʻa e Talanoa ʻo Sīsū ʻo Fakataha
HomeHero.togetherDescription: Koeʻuhí ke nau fanongo mo sio ki he ʻofa ʻa Sīsū ʻi heʻenau lea tonu pē ʻi he feituʻu ʻoku nau ʻi ai.

Mission.eyebrow: Langa ki he ngāue fakamisiona ʻi māmani
Mission.headline: ʻOku ʻikai liliu ʻa e pōpoakí. ʻOku liliu ʻa e founga ʻoku sio ai ʻa e kakaí.
Mission.intro: ʻOku mau toe langa mei hono tefitoʻi tupuʻanga ʻemau laipeli vitio mo e ngaahi meʻangāue, ʻo ʻave ʻa e ngaahi hongofulu taʻu ʻo e ngāue liliu ki he ngaahi feituʻu ʻoku ʻosi fakataha, sio, mo vahevahe ai ʻa e kakaí.
Mission.libraryPointTitle: Ko e laipeli filimi kuo liliu lahi taha ʻi māmani
Mission.libraryPointDescription: Ko e ngaahi hongofulu taʻu ʻo e ngāue liliu, ʻaki ʻa e ngaahi hoa ngāue fakafaifekau falalaʻanga, kuo ne langa ha laipeli ʻoku ʻi ai ʻa e ngaahi lea ʻe lauiafe, koeʻuhí ke fetaulaki ʻa e kakaí mo e talanoa ʻo Sīsū ʻi he lea ʻoku ongo loloto taha kiate kinautolu.
Mission.formatsPointTitle: ʻAve ʻa e ngaahi leʻo falalaʻanga ki ha ngaahi fōtunga foʻou
Mission.formatsPointDescription: ʻOku mau toe langa ʻa e founga ʻoku fakamatalaʻi fakaʻata ai ʻa e ngaahi talanoa ʻo e ongoongoleleí, ʻo fakatahaʻi ʻa e ngaahi liliu falalaʻanga mo e ngaahi fōtunga fakaonopooni koeʻuhí ke ʻalu tauʻatāina ʻa e pōpoakí ʻi he ngaahi feituʻu, anga fakafonua, mo e ngaahi sikilini kehekehe.
Mission.teamPointTitle: Lahi ange ia ʻi ha laipeli. Ko ha timi ʻoku tataki ʻe he misiona.
Mission.teamPointDescription: Ko e Jesus Film Project ko ha timi fakamāmani lahi ʻo e kau liliu lea, kau taukei mītia, kau ʻētita, mo e kau faʻu, ʻoku nau liliu ʻa e ngaahi hongofulu taʻu ʻo e aʻusia fakafaifekau ki he ngaahi meʻangāue maʻá e kau fakaʻākonga ʻi he feituʻu kotoa pē.
Mission.highlightsHeading: Ko e meʻa ʻoku mau langa hoko
Mission.nextStepsTitle: Tuʻungaʻanga ʻo e Ngaahi Sitepu Hoko
Mission.nextStepsDescription: Fakafehokotaki ʻa e kau mamata ki ha ngaahi faingamālie moʻoni ʻi heʻenau fononga fakalaumālie, ʻo tokoniʻi kinautolu ke fai ha sitepu hoko ki ha kāinga lotu, ki he Folofola, pe ki he misiona.
Mission.mediaLibraryDescription: Ko ha laipeli mītia Kalisitiane lahi ʻoku ʻi ai ʻa e ngaahi vitio, filimi, mo e ngaahi maʻuʻanga tokoni ʻe lauiafe ʻi he ngaahi lea kehekehe, maʻá e ngāue fakafaifekau mo e malangaʻi ʻo e ongoongoleleí ʻi māmani lahi.
Mission.ministryToolsTitle: Ngaahi Meʻangāue Fakatisitale maʻá e Ngaahi Ngāue Fakafaifekau
Mission.ministryToolsDescription: Ngaahi meʻangāue ki hono pule ʻo e vitio, tufaki ʻo e ngaahi meʻa, fetuʻutaki mo e kau mamata, mo e vakaiʻi ʻo e ngaahi fika, kuo faʻu ke tokoniʻi ʻa e ngaahi ngāue fakafaifekau ke aʻu lelei ange ki ha kakai tokolahi ange.
Mission.inviteHeadline: Tokoni ke langa ʻa e {accent} ʻo e ngaahi meʻangāue fakamisiona
Mission.inviteBody: ʻOku mau fakaafeʻi ʻa e kau ngāue, kau faʻu, mo e ngaahi hoa ngāue ke nau kau muʻomuʻa mai. Sivi ʻuluaki ʻa e ngaahi meʻangāue foʻou, ʻoange hoʻo fakakaukau, pea tokoni ke fakafōtunga ʻa e ngaahi meʻa kuo faʻu maʻá e ngāue fakamisiona moʻoni.
Mission.betaCta: Hoko ko ha tokotaha sivi ʻuluaki
